title: A strategy must say when not to use it
summary: If your investment strategy has no conditions under which you would stop it or alter it, it is a habit, not a strategy. If you say it works in all environments, you do not understand when it fails. A true strategy tells you what to do and also when not to do it. The speaker asks viewers to share their strategy and when it should not be used.

steps.caption: Illustration: a strategy that sells a put when its entry conditions are met.
The short put strike: the level this example strategy depends on.
The environment changes. An example stop condition (not from the clip): stop or alter the strategy here.
With no condition to stop or alter it, you keep running it as the environment turns against it.

takeaways: A strategy with no conditions under which you would stop or alter it is a habit, not a strategy.
If you say your strategy works in all environments, you do not understand when it fails.
A true strategy says what to do and also when not to do it.
